title: Unbreakable Bubbles
subtitle: The most ideal composition of this photo would be having a bubble gently landing on the muzzle of the loaded gun.

trails.title: Collage Art
trails.description: A popular collage credited to an anonymous artist which takes up half of the newspaper page. The sections surrounding it are left empty, like [the absent mind.]

content.text: A COLLAGE MADE OF OLD NEWS

{p}Doctor Introduced Lobotomy Won Nobel Prize
The Little Known Dada work
Race Relations Act Received Royal Assent
The British Museum Is Falling Down
{p}{img}{p}
{p}Ramirez Declared Bankruptcy
Police Starts Investigation on Cracker Incident at Big Ben, Suspect Remains At Large
Pirate Radio Goes to Ban List
"Tomorrow Has Arrived"

items.text: The fans keep working and generate a continuous gale.
Dust, fragments, and strange magnets stick to the cover of the ventilation. Some of them scatter and linger above Iverson's head.
Some magnetic chips dance in the air and tightly stick to the robots when they get close.
The robots, trapped by magnets, start to spin around. Some even lose their mobility.
Iverson is too busy to take care of those messy robots. There's a thick cloud above his head. His anger will burst out at any time.

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: Nasty invader!

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: I am sorry, Mr. Iverson. Actually, I didn't know my entrance would be so straightforward.

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: I think she knows the situation better than ... Hmm? Where is she?!

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: It seems you are the abandoned, poor worm.

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: What else are you going to show me? Any jokes of the never-will-happen Utopia?

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: It may be unrealistic, but it is possible.
Right after Diggers's feeble words, a huge bubble floats in front of him.

items.speaker: Visitor
items.text: Whoa, lots of bubbles ...

items.speaker: Visitor
items.text: Is this the special event of the exhibition?

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: These soap bubbles are ...?

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: Ah, I see. The ventilation system is switched on. The soap bubble device I threw outside is now functioning!
This is what Diggers has been expecting for a long time—a gale to sweep the old world.
The soap bubble device eventually catches everyone's attention.
The colourful Reflective Bubbles start their wandering.

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: Excuse me, may I borrow your broken robots?

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: Stop! What the hell did you do! What are these damn bubbles?

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: Actually, it is a reformation of art.
Diggers steps on the head of the security robot, where everyone can see him.

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: Get down from there! You bastard!

items.speaker: Young Visitor
items.text: Mum, it's that weird man!

items.speaker: Young Visitor
items.text: Is he provoking the robots?

items.speaker: Visitor
items.text: Hahh! He did sign the Safety Commitment Statement, right?

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: My friends, have you been fed up with the dull and dreary reality?

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: Do you want to get rid of this place of cliche and red tape?

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: You once yearned for a better world, a peaceful world with music.

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: Open your eyes and look at the soap bubbles in front of you, now!

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: And salute to all the transient beauties.
More and more colourful soap bubbles show up in the hall. They reflect the people's curious eyes, floating up and down in the air as if doing the most popular twist at the time.
Some visitors start to shake their bodies. Under the light reflected by the soap bubbles, more and more people join in.
Eventually, they become an ocean of joy.

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Woof woof ... woof.
Pickles tries to wake Charlton up with his paws but fails.

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Woof woof …
Pickles tries to wake Charlton up with his paws, through barking and licking, but none of them work.

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Woof woof.

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: Get this hooligan out of here!
Iverson grasps the remote control. The buttons are tightly squeezed.

items.speaker: Security Robot
items.text: Sedative spray ready to deploy.

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: Don't you want to try some of these bubbles, Mr. Iverson?

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: We can find a peaceful way to coexist.
Pop!
Iverson violently pricks and destroys all the bubbles approaching him. A mixed scent of Lou mucus and rose oil immediately captures his nose.

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: Boring little trick.
Bubbles keep breaking around Iverson, but he is indifferent.

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: Aren't you curious at all?

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: Take a look at it, and you'll activate every cell of art. Even iron nerds can spark all their imagination.

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: Don't tell me your imagination level is null.

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: Joking time over.
He puts the remote control into his pocket.

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: Your Utopia has always been a joke.

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: Only hegemony, hatred, and force can push history forward.

items.speaker: Iverson
items.text: Vain revolt is like helpless barking.

Iverson grabs a robot's weapon forcefully. His "employees" have finally regained consciousness.
The silent robots approach slowly and surround Diggers.

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: Perhaps I will be expelled from this impromptu party, away from its artistic beauty, and forced to bid farewell to my new friends ...

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: Perhaps people as insensible, cold, and numb as you will become mainstream in the end ...

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: But, it is not now.
TO BE CONTINUED ...
